gbdt_walk_dev_step.note: The leaf walk's line-search step lives in a device word formed by walker_accept_kernel from the accept flag (1 after a taken point, half after a rejected one, the host walker's statements); a walk enqueues its first iterations evaluations behind one drain instead of one drain per evaluation. Bit-neutral (same kernels, same inputs, same order). Logloss's 10 Newton iterations: 10 drains per estimation round -> 1. NOT COMPILED, NOT MEASURED.

gbdt_ord_tree_bufs.note: Ordered boosting's per-tree scratch (two search planes, bins, noise partials and terms, bootstrap draws, |planes|, magnitudes) allocated once per fit off the FAST wide path, as fast_planes/fast_bins are; every cell written before it is read each tree. Bit-neutral. NOT COMPILED, NOT MEASURED.

fa_svd_group.note: FactorAnalysis FAST Apple grid SVD: 4 Jacobi sweeps behind one wait with xd_flag_first_kernel (main's IDENTICAL svd driver) instead of one wait and readback per sweep. Bit-neutral. NOT COMPILED, NOT MEASURED.

fa_gram_spread.note: FactorAnalysis FAST Apple Gram pass: rows per partial ceil(n / 64) rounded to a slab, between 256 and 8192, so small n runs on >= 64 threadgroups instead of 1-3. FAST bits move (fold order over partials); quality check mean_log_likelihood vs FAST main. NOT COMPILED, NOT MEASURED.
